id.description: The unique ID of the accounting category.

name.description: The name of the accounting category.

code.description: The code of the accounting category.

created_at.description: The date and time the accounting category was created in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

updated_at.description: The date and time the accounting category was last updated in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

default_tax_rate_id.description: The ID of the default [tax rate](https://developer.revolut.com/docs/api/business#get-tax-rate) applied to items in this accounting category unless overridden for a specific item.
